company.name: Market Researcher AI
company.description: An AI-powered platform that conducts market research interviews via voice calls, replacing manual interview processes with intelligent, adaptive AI agents

product.name: Market Researcher Agent
product.description: An AI voice agent that calls users to conduct structured market research interviews. It adapts its questions based on the respondent's background, captures insights in real-time, and generates structured analysis reports.
keyFeatures: Adaptive questioning based on respondent background
Post-call structured analysis with sentiment detection
Scalable - run hundreds of interviews simultaneously
product.targetAudience: Product managers, startup founders, UX researchers, and market research professionals

research.objective: Understand how potential users currently conduct market research interviews and validate demand for an AI-powered solution

questions.text: Can you tell me about your role and what kind of products or services you work on?
questions.followUp: How long have you been doing this kind of work?

questions.text: How do you currently gather feedback or insights from your users or customers?
questions.followUp: How often do you conduct these research activities?

questions.text: What are the biggest challenges you face when trying to do user research or market research?
questions.followUp: How much time and effort does the current process typically take?

questions.text: If an AI agent could conduct research interviews on your behalf, what would be most valuable to you?
questions.followUp: What would make you trust the quality of AI-conducted interviews?

questions.text: Are you currently using any tools or services to help with user research?
questions.followUp: What do you like or dislike about those tools?

questions.text: If a tool like this existed, what would you expect to pay for it?
questions.followUp: Would you prefer per-interview pricing or a monthly subscription?

concerns: Users may not trust AI for qualitative research that requires empathy and nuance
Respondents might behave differently talking to an AI vs a human interviewer
Quality of insights may not match experienced human researchers
Privacy concerns around AI recording and analyzing conversations

productMarketFit.hypothesis: Product teams and researchers need a faster, cheaper way to conduct qualitative interviews at scale
signals: Manual interview scheduling and conducting is time-consuming
Teams often skip research due to cost and time constraints
Existing survey tools lack the depth of conversational interviews
Growing acceptance of AI in professional workflows
